world.label: Subdued
world.headline: Global economy subdued (41). Main driver: a supply shock, with goods moving less while oil prices rise.

drivers: Ship traffic at Strait of Hormuz is down 96% on a year ago.
Ship traffic at Bosporus is down 49% on a year ago.
Middle East port cargo is down 70% on a year ago.
South Asia port cargo is up 50% on a year ago.
Europe natural gas is up 162% on a year ago.
Brent crude is up 93% on a year ago.
WTI crude is up 62% on a year ago.
Sahm rule recession signal (unemployment rising fast): France, Italy, Austria, Colombia, Finland, Luxembourg, Latvia, Estonia, Iceland.
